Daniel, TravelBank sits in one of the most competitive corners of fintech, corporate travel and expense, where buyers are weighing several platforms at once.

I built a personalized signal play for TravelBank off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
